name: Chinese Medical Hallucination Evaluation (CMHE)
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to detect medical hallucinations, make accurate diagnoses in noisy conditions, and provide plausible explanations, focusing on the challenge of snowballing hallucinations in healthcare applications.
reputation: A recent medical hallucination benchmark that is still emerging and not yet broadly established as a community standard.
notes: Uses ICD-10 and MeSH glossaries to aid evaluation; combines manual and model-based approaches for benchmark creation.
